# A level without exits loses its sign's message when the editor saves it, seen in the editor (851-3618;
# docs/quirks.md section 1). levels/s.lvl, as in editor-sign-no-exit.txt, has no entrance or exit and one sign,
# HELLO, written in the loader's layout (exit count 0 and sign count 1 on lines of their own). F2, S
# and Enter (220-227) open it in the editor, which draws HELLO at the sign; Escape and Y (240, 250) save it, and
# with no exit names the editor writes the two counts on one line, 01. F2, S and Enter again (262-286) reopen
# it: the editor reads one exit name (HELLO, which no exit takes) and no sign messages, so the sign has no
# message and nothing is drawn at it. Escape and N (350, 360) leave without saving. The window is 3x
# (screenScale 3).

# story: oMsgSign.message=""@286 room=rTitle@360
